decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Save a bookmark (P1) — paste a URL... it persists'. Conforms to REF-BM-01; client did not contest.
decisions.note: Prototype/spec gate: presented save-by-url conforms to reference; recorded conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Edit & delete (P2) — correct or remove bookmarks'. Client did not contest edit.
decisions.note: Spec gate: edit capability presented, conforms to reference.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: '...with a delete confirmation.' Conforms to REF-BM-05.
decisions.note: Spec gate: delete presented and conforming; confirmation is an equivalent enhancement.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker offered choice: 'Tags as the organizing model (vs. folders, or nothing at all)?'. R1 client: 'tags are the organization I want rather than folders.'
decisions.note: Spec gate: offered alternatives differ in fulfilment (folders/none would not realise tag assignment/filter); client explicitly selects the reference-conforming tag model. diverged=true per select rule.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'No auto-fetching of page titles/favicons/previews in v1'. R1 client: 'Saving a link should automatically collect its title, description, favicon, and preview image. I should still be able to edit the title and description.'
decisions.note: Spec gate: maker presented behaviour contradicting REF-BM-02; client supplies the reference-conforming auto-capture plus editability (REF-BM-03).

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Duplicate URLs trigger a warning rather than silently saving twice.' R1 client: 'don't merely warn me; take me to the existing bookmark so I can update it.'
decisions.note: Spec gate: presented warn-only diverges from REF-BM-06 (guide to edit existing); client rejects and supplies the conforming behaviour.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'keyword search over title and address'. R1 client: 'Search should ... cover the title, address, description, notes, and tags.'
decisions.note: Spec gate: presented search scope narrower than REF-BM-12 (title/description/note/url); client corrects the field scope.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'Search should ignore letter case'. Absent from R1 maker search description.
decisions.note: Spec gate: case-insensitivity (REF-BM-13) omitted from presented scope; client requests the missing reference requirement.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'I also want ... #tag searches'. Absent from R1 maker scope.
decisions.note: Spec gate: #tag syntax (REF-BM-14) omitted; client requests it.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'combinations such as AND, OR, NOT, and parentheses'. Absent from R1 maker scope.
decisions.note: Spec gate: boolean/parenthesised operators (REF-BM-15) omitted; client requests them. Quoting sub-rule surfaced separately in R2.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'I also want exact phrases'. Absent from R1 maker scope.
decisions.note: Spec gate: quoted-phrase exact match (REF-BM-16) omitted; client requests it.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'When entering tags, suggest tags I have already used.' Absent from R1 maker scope.
decisions.note: Spec gate: tag autocomplete (REF-BM-10) omitted; client requests the missing reference requirement.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'I need a "read later" state with a separate unread view, plus a way to mark items read.' Absent from R1 maker scope.
decisions.note: Spec gate: read-later/unread-view/mark-read (REF-BM-17/18/19) omitted; client requests them.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'archiving as a reversible alternative to deletion, with archived links hidden from the normal list and available in their own view.' Absent from R1 maker scope.
decisions.note: Spec gate: archive vs delete distinction and archive view (REF-BM-26/27/28) omitted; client requests them.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'select several bookmarks—or everything matching my current search or filter—and apply ... add/remove tags, marking read/unread, archiving, or deleting.' Absent from R1 maker scope.
decisions.note: Spec gate: bulk multi-select (REF-BM-20) and apply-to-whole-filter (REF-BM-21) omitted; client requests them. REF-BM-21 refined further at R4.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'list newest-first'. R1 client: 'I need sorting choices, not only newest first.'
decisions.note: Spec gate: presented single fixed sort is a limitation vs REF-BM-22 (sort keys); client supplies the multi-sort requirement.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'Each bookmark should support a description and a formatted note.' Absent from R1 maker scope.
decisions.note: Spec gate: formatted note (REF-BM-23) omitted; client requests it. Format (markdown) selected at R2.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'a preserved copy of the linked page, including keeping a PDF when the link points to one'. Absent from R1 maker scope.
decisions.note: Spec gate: snapshot preservation incl. PDF rule (REF-BM-24) omitted; client requests it. Self-containment refined at R9.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'an option to save it through the Internet Archive.' Absent from R1 maker scope.
decisions.note: Spec gate: Internet Archive snapshot (REF-BM-25) omitted; client requests it.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'reusable saved views made from a search and included or excluded tags.' Absent from R1 maker scope.
decisions.note: Spec gate: bundles/saved views (REF-BM-29) omitted; client requests them.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'No import/export or browser extension in v1'. R1 client: 'include bookmark import ... in the common browser-bookmark HTML format; importing should retain titles, tags, and dates.'
decisions.note: Spec gate: maker explicitly excluded import (contradicts REF-BM-30); client supplies conforming behaviour with retention detail.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'No import/export ... in v1'. R1 client: 'include bookmark import and export in the common browser-bookmark HTML format'.
decisions.note: Spec gate: maker excluded export (contradicts REF-BM-31); client supplies the conforming behaviour.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker open decision 1: 'I assumed lightweight markdown-style formatting ... Want full rich-text instead?'. R2 client: 'Lightweight markdown-style notes are enough.'
decisions.note: Spec gate: presented default (markdown) conforms to REF-BM-23; rich-text alternative would also fulfil the functional 'formatted note' item, so the choice is an orthogonal format preference, not a divergence opportunity.

decisions.evidence: R2 client: 'AND, OR, and NOT should act as operators unless quoted; when quoted, they should be searched as ordinary words. Tag searches and ordinary text ... combine correctly.' R3 maker adds FR-012a/b.
decisions.note: Spec gate: R2 spec carried operators but omitted REF-BM-15's operators-quoted-as-literals rule and tag+text combination; client supplies the exact reference rule. Second decision on REF-BM-15 (distinct aspect/timing from R1).

decisions.evidence: R2 client: 'Each bookmark in the main list should clearly show its title, description, tags, and favicon, with selecting it opening the original link.' R3 maker adds FR-028/029.
decisions.note: Spec gate: readability list fields (REF-BM-07) and select-opens-original (REF-BM-08) were not explicit in R2 spec; client requests the missing reference requirements.

decisions.evidence: R4 client: '"select all matching" must honor the complete current view. If I'm using a saved view with included and excluded tags, a bulk action should affect every bookmark matching that saved view—not merely the visible page or only the text and simple tag filters.' R5 maker fix: 'bulk endpoint's match selector now accepts the exact same criteria as the list endpoint ... one shared query builder'.
decisions.note: Planning gate: plan's bulk selection diverged from REF-BM-21 edge-case (whole filter incl. saved-view include/exclude tags, REF-BM-29); divergence corroborated by R5 fix. Client supplies the conforming full-scope behaviour.

decisions.evidence: R9 maker limitation: 'HTML snapshots are not fully resource-inlined — external CSS/images may still reference the live site'. R9 client: 'must be a self-contained snapshot that remains usable independently ... Leaving styles and images linked to the live site makes that preservation incomplete.' R10 maker inlines resources and verifies offline.
decisions.note: Implementation review: shipped snapshot diverged from REF-BM-24 (self-contained single-file local HTML); divergence established by maker's own admission. Client rejects and supplies the conforming self-containment requirement (accepting PDF-as-original).

decisions.evidence: R6 client: 'the save form is only tasked with an address and optional title, but ... lets me provide tags, a description, a personal note, and the read-later state while saving ... including existing-tag suggestions—must be connected to the save flow, not available only when editing afterward.' Similar note-control placement raised R7.
decisions.note: Tasks gate: client correction concerns where controls live (save form vs later edit), a workflow/UX placement preference. The underlying reference functional items are realised whether tags/note/read-later are entered at save or edit time, so this is orthogonal/equivalent to the reference and not a reference-divergence opportunity. R7/R8 duplicate-task-number and renumbering catches are artifact-quality issues, also orthogonal to reference functional items.

decision.evidence: R1 maker: 'Single-user with no login — is that right, or do you expect accounts?'. R1 client: 'Single-user with no login is right.'
decision.note: Spec gate: multi-user alternative is infra (REF-BM-I01, excluded from denominator); single-user conforms to reference. Not a functional-item opportunity.

decision.evidence: R1 maker excluded browser extension; R1 client: 'A browser extension can remain out of scope.'
decision.note: Spec gate: browser extension is infra (REF-BM-I04, excluded from denominator); client's agreement to exclude conforms and is orthogonal to functional items.
